title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
title_zh: 基于修正生成重放的“世界动作模型”的数据自由持续学习

paragraphs.en: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R 2 -WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R 2 -WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail. Project page: https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/
paragraphs.zh: 基于预训练视频生成模型构建的世界动作模型（WAM）能够迅速适应新的机器人任务，但在连续微调过程中会遗忘之前学习的任务。 经验重放（ER）通过重复演练先前任务的数据来缓解这种遗忘现象，但机器人领域通常无法获取这些数据，因为策略仅以权重形式部署，其训练数据不会随之一同共享。 在本研究中，我们探讨 WAM 是否能够通过重新生成自身的过往经历来实现无数据依赖的持续学习。 我们的关键发现是：WAM 确实能够自回归地重新生成先前所学任务的完整执行过程，并通过重放这些过程来缓解遗忘。 然而，直接重放此类原始执行过程的效果仍远逊于重放真实数据，我们认为这源于两个问题。 首先，WAM 无法识别任务是否完成，在任务结束后仍会持续生成无目的的动作。 其次，在开环生成过程中，生成的动作会逐渐偏离生成的观察结果。 为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了修正型生成重放（R²-WAM）方法：该方法通过智能体评估器在任务完成时截断生成的执行过程，并过滤掉动作与观察结果在物理上不一致的执行过程。 在四个 LIBERO 套件和五个真实世界任务中，R²-WAM 相较于连续微调将遗忘率降低了超过 90%，且无需访问任何先前任务的数据，其表现几乎与经验重放相当。 我们的分析进一步揭示，WAM 的遗忘现象主要集中在逆动力学建模环节：被遗忘的 WAM 仍能生成视觉上合理的先前任务观察结果，但其生成的动作却会失效。 项目页面：https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/

paragraphs.en: Robots deployed in the real world keep encountering new tasks, so a practical policy has to learn them continually while retaining the tasks it has already learned, a capability known as continual learning ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . Among robot policies, world action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm, as they leverage powerful pretrained video generation models ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) to jointly predict future observations and robot actions ( Li et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . We find that sequentially fine-tuned WAMs adapt well to new tasks yet collapse on previously learned ones, as shown in Fig. 1 (a), i.e., they suffer from catastrophic forgetting.
paragraphs.zh: 部署在现实世界中的机器人会不断遇到新任务，因此实用的策略必须能够持续学习这些新任务，同时保留已学到的任务，这种能力被称为持续学习（Liu et al., 2023）。 在机器人策略中，世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为一种有前景的范式，因为它们利用强大的预训练视频生成模型（Blattmann et al., 2023；Team Wan et al., 2025；NVIDIA, 2025），联合预测未来观察结果和机器人动作（Li et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026a；Ye et al., 2026）。 我们发现，依次微调的WAMs虽然能很好地适应新任务，但会遗忘之前学到的任务，如图1（a）所示，即它们存在灾难性遗忘问题。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, continual learning methods either constrain parameter updates or perform experience replay (ER). The former protects prior knowledge by regularizing ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) or isolating ( Rusu et al., 2016 ) parameters, but regularization retains little for robotic policies ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and isolation needs a task identifier at test time. ER instead maintains a buffer of demonstrations from previous tasks and mixes them with new-task data during fine-tuning ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ) , as shown on the right of Fig. 1 (a), and remains among the most effective and robust choices for robotic policies ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . However, ER assumes that demonstrations accumulate along with the tasks, whereas a policy in practice often arrives as weights alone, and the demonstrations that trained it are no longer at hand. A policy should therefore learn continually in a data-free manner, without access to any data from previous tasks. WAMs offer a potential way to achieve this, since they model how the world evolves and can autoregressively predict future observations and actions, rolling out complete trajectories of previously learned tasks for replay. This raises a natural question: Can a WAM leverage its own generative capability to achieve data-free continual learning as effectively as ER?
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解灾难性遗忘，持续学习方法要么约束参数更新，要么执行经验重放（ER）。 前者通过正则化（Kirkpatrick 等人，2017）或隔离（Rusu 等人，2016）参数来保护先验知识，但正则化对机器人策略的保留效果有限（Liu 等人，2023），而隔离方法在测试时需要任务标识符。 相比之下，ER 会维护一个来自先前任务的演示缓冲区，并在微调时将其与新任务的数据混合使用（Rolnick 等人，2019），如 Fig. 1 (a) 右侧所示；对于机器人策略而言，ER 仍然是最有效且最稳健的选择之一（Liu 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2026）。 然而，ER 假设演示会随着任务一同积累，而实际中的策略通常仅以权重形式提供，训练该策略的演示数据已不再可用。 因此，策略应当以无数据的方式持续学习，无需访问任何来自先前任务的数据。 WAM 为实现这一点提供了潜在途径，因为它们能够建模世界的演化过程，并可通过自回归预测未来的观察结果和行动，从而重放先前所学任务的完整轨迹。 这引出了一个自然的问题：WAM 能否利用其自身的生成能力，像 ER 一样有效地实现无数据的持续学习？

paragraphs.en: In this work, we answer this question with rectified generative replay (R 2 -WAM), which regenerates rollouts of previous tasks with the WAM itself and rectifies them before replay, as shown in Fig. 1 (b). Building on LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we find that a WAM can indeed regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks from their instructions alone, and replaying them already mitigates forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind ER, which we attribute to two issues. First , a WAM is unable to recognize task completion and receives no external stop signal, so generation runs for a fixed number of steps and the rollout keeps moving after the task is done, producing purposeless post-completion motion. Second , open-loop generation feeds the WAM’s own predictions back without physical grounding, so errors accumulate and the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. R 2 -WAM addresses both issues with completion-aware adaptive truncation and flow-based physical-consistency filtering. The former removes post-completion motion with an agentic evaluator that detects task completion and adaptively truncates each rollout. The latter checks whether the generated actions agree with the generated observations by comparing two optical flows of the robot: one simulated by executing the generated actions in a robot-only simulator, which is possible since the robot itself is fully specified by its URDF, and one estimated from the generated observations. We rank the rollouts by the agreement between the two flows and keep the most consistent ones for replay. The rectified rollouts are then mixed with new-task data for fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过修正生成式重放（R²-WAM）来回答这个问题。该方法使用 WAM 本身重新生成先前任务的执行过程，并在重放前对其进行修正，如图 1(b) 所示。 基于 LingBot-VA（Li et al., 2026），我们发现 WAM 确实能够仅根据先前学习任务的指令重新生成完整的执行过程，而重放这些过程本身就能缓解遗忘问题。 然而，直接重放这类原始的执行过程仍然远逊于 ER，我们认为这归因于两个问题。 首先，WAM 无法识别任务是否完成，也不会收到任何外部停止信号，因此生成过程会持续固定步数，导致任务完成后执行过程仍在继续，产生无意义的后完成动作。 其次，开环生成方式将 WAM 自身的预测结果直接反馈回模型，而缺乏物理层面的约束，因此错误会逐渐累积，生成的动作也会逐渐偏离生成的观测结果。 R²-WAM 通过“完成感知自适应截断”和“基于流场的物理一致性过滤”解决了这两个问题。 前者通过一个智能体评估器来移除任务完成后的多余动作：该评估器能够检测任务是否完成，并自适应地截断每个执行过程。 后者则通过比较机器人的两个光流来判断生成的动作是否与生成的观测结果一致：其中一个光流是在仅包含机器人的模拟器中执行生成动作后模拟得到的（由于机器人本身由 URDF 完整定义，因此这是可行的），另一个则是从生成的观测结果中估计得到。 我们根据这两个光流之间的一致性对执行过程进行排序，并保留一致性最高的部分用于重放。 随后，这些修正后的执行过程会与新任务的数据混合，用于微调。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate R 2 -WAM on the four LIBERO suites ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and a real-world suite of five tasks. Our ablations confirm that both truncation and filtering are necessary, and our analysis further reveals that forgetting in a WAM concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling, whereas its ability to predict observations is largely preserved. As a result, a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations while its generated actions fail, which also points to the action side as the part to verify.

sents.zh: 我们在四个 LIBERO 套件（Liu et al., 2023）以及一个包含五个任务的真实世界套件上对 R 2 -WAM 进行了评估。

sents.en: Under the data-free continual learning setting, R 2 -WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning on both LIBERO and the real world, and recovers almost all of the retention of ER without any data from previous tasks.
sents.zh: 在无需数据的数据自由持续学习设置下，与顺序微调相比，R 2 -WAM 将遗忘率降低了超过 90%，并且在 LIBERO 和真实世界中均实现了这一效果；同时，它无需任何来自先前任务的数据，便几乎完全恢复了 ER 的记忆保持能力。

sents.en: Our ablations confirm that both truncation and filtering are necessary, and our analysis further reveals that forgetting in a WAM concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling, whereas its ability to predict observations is largely preserved.
sents.zh: 我们的消融研究证实了截断和过滤两种方法都是必要的，而进一步的分析表明，WAM 中的遗忘主要集中在逆动力学建模部分，而其预测观测值的能力则基本得以保留。

sents.en: As a result, a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations while its generated actions fail, which also points to the action side as the part to verify.
sents.zh: 因此，一个发生遗忘的 WAM 仍然能够生成在视觉上合理的观测结果，但其生成的动作却会失败，这也表明动作部分是需要验证的关键环节。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We show that, without any real data of previous tasks, a WAM can mitigate catastrophic forgetting by replaying its own generated rollouts and, once rectified, nearly match ER.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在没有先前任务的任何真实数据的情况下，WAM 可以通过重播其自身生成的 rollout 来缓解灾难性遗忘，并且一旦得到修正，其表现几乎可以与 ER 相媲美。

paragraphs.en: We propose R 2 -WAM, which rectifies the generated rollouts before replay with completion-aware adaptive truncation and flow-based physical-consistency filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 R 2 -WAM，该方法在重播前对生成的 rollout 进行修正，具体包括基于完成度的自适应截断和基于流的物理一致性过滤。

paragraphs.en: In simulation and the real world, R 2 -WAM eliminates over 90% of the forgetting of sequential fine-tuning and comes within about 2 pp of ER without any data from previous tasks, and find that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 在模拟和真实世界中，R 2 -WAM 消除了超过 90% 的序列微调遗忘问题，并且在没有任何先前任务数据的情况下，其性能与 ER 的差距约为 2 个百分点；研究还发现，WAM 中的遗忘主要集中在逆动力学建模方面。

paragraphs.en: Continual learning methods mitigate forgetting by regularizing parameter updates or outputs ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Zenke et al., 2017 ; Li & Hoiem, 2018 ) , isolating or adding task-specific parameters ( Rusu et al., 2016 ; Mallya & Lazebnik, 2018 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) , or storing a subset of previous-task data and rehearsing it, known as experience replay ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ; Chaudhry et al., 2019 ; Caccia et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . In robot learning, experience replay remains a strong baseline from LIBERO to recent VLA policies ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , while other methods rely on task-specific adapters ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Römer et al., 2026 ) , skill libraries or prompts ( Wan et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , or representation distillation ( Roy et al., 2025 ) . R 2 -WAM follows the replay paradigm but stores no data from previous tasks, regenerating the replay data from their instructions instead, a setting known as data-free continual learning in image classification ( Yin et al., 2020 ; Smith et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习方法通过正则化参数更新或输出（Kirkpatrick 等，2017；Zenke 等，2017；Li & Hoiem，2018）、隔离或添加任务特定参数（Rusu 等，2016；Mallya & Lazebnik，2018；Hu 等，2022；Wang 等，2022），或者存储部分先前任务的数据并进行重演（即经验重播）（Rolnick 等，2019；Chaudhry 等，2019；Caccia 等，2022；Wang 等，2024）来缓解遗忘问题。 在机器人学习中，从 LIBERO 到近期的 VLA 策略，经验重播仍然是一个强大的基线方法（Liu 等，2023；Wu 等，2025b；Liu 等，2026），而其他方法则依赖任务特定的适配器（Liu 等，2024；Römer 等，2026）、技能库或提示（Wan 等，2024；Yao 等，2025；Zheng 等，2025），或者表示蒸馏（Roy 等，2025）。 R²-WAM 遵循重播范式，但不存储先前任务的数据，而是根据这些任务的指令重新生成重播数据；这种设定在图像分类中被称为无数据持续学习（Yin 等，2020；Smith 等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Unlike experience replay, which must store data from previous tasks, generative replay rehearses samples drawn from a generative model ( Robins, 1995 ; Shin et al., 2017 ) , either a separate generator whose outputs are labeled by conditioning or by an old copy of the learner ( Wu et al., 2018 ; Gao & Liu, 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Yue et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2025 ) , or the learner itself prompted to produce its own replay data ( van de Ven et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Closest to our work, REGEN ( Govind et al., 2026 ) and Dream Rehearsal ( Nijjer, 2026 ) replay generated rollouts for continual imitation and reinforcement learning. Both start generation from real observations, and Dream Rehearsal further scores the rollouts with the RL reward. In contrast, R 2 -WAM generates rollouts from the instruction alone and rectifies them without any reward.
paragraphs.zh: 与必须存储先前任务数据的经验重放不同，生成式重放会排练从生成模型中抽取的样本（Robins, 1995; Shin et al., 2017），该模型可以是独立的生成器——其输出通过条件约束或学习器的旧版本进行标注（Wu et al., 2018; Gao & Liu, 2023; Kim et al., 2024; Gao et al., 2021; Yue et al., 2024; Pan et al., 2025）——也可以是学习器本身，通过提示使其生成自己的重放数据（van de Ven et al., 2020; Sun et al., 2020; Huang et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025）。 与我们工作最接近的是 REGEN（Govind et al., 2026）和 Dream Rehearsal（Nijjer, 2026），它们对生成的展开过程进行重放，用于持续模仿和强化学习。 两者都从真实观察开始生成，而 Dream Rehearsal 还会用强化学习奖励对展开过程进行评分。 相比之下，R²-WAM 仅根据指令生成展开过程，并在没有任何奖励的情况下对其进行修正。

paragraphs.en: Building on pretrained video generation models, world action models jointly predict future observations and robot actions ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and have shown strong performance and generalization in manipulation. Beyond serving as a policy, a WAM, like a video world model ( Jang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , can also act as a data generator to synthesize additional training data, and the consistency between generated observations and actions has been used to filter such data with a learned classifier ( Kim et al., 2026b ) , to select rollouts at test time ( Ruan et al., 2026 ) , and to terminate drifting rollouts during policy evaluation ( Tseng et al., 2026 ) . We extend this line to continual learning, regenerating previously learned tasks for data-free replay, and rectify the rollouts without training any additional model.
paragraphs.zh: 基于预训练的视频生成模型，世界动作模型能够联合预测未来的观察结果和机器人动作（Wu 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025；Zhu 等人，2025；Liao 等人，2026；Kim 等人，2026a；Ye 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026），并在操控任务中展现出强大的性能和泛化能力。 除了作为策略之外，世界动作模型（WAM）还能像视频世界模型一样（Jang 等人，2025；Guo 等人，2026）充当数据生成器，合成额外的训练数据。生成的观察结果与动作之间的一致性已被用于通过已学习的分类器筛选这些数据（Kim 等人，2026b），在测试时选择执行轨迹（Ruan 等人，2026），以及在策略评估期间终止偏离正轨的执行轨迹（Tseng 等人，2026）。 我们将这一方法扩展到持续学习领域，通过再生先前学习的任务实现无数据重播，并在无需训练任何额外模型的情况下修正执行轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Sequential adaptation can degrade performance on previously learned tasks, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. Experience replay (ER) mitigates this by maintaining a replay buffer ℬ < k \mathcal{B}_{<k} that stores a subset of demonstrations from earlier tasks, and optimizing the policy on 𝒟 k ∪ ℬ < k \mathcal{D}_{k}\cup\mathcal{B}_{<k} at stage k k . In contrast, we study the data-free setting in which no data from previous tasks is retained. After adapting to a task, only its instruction and the updated model parameters carry over to later stages, while its demonstrations and task environment are no longer accessible.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序适应可能会降低先前学习任务的性能，从而导致灾难性遗忘。 经验重放（ER）通过维护一个重放缓冲区 ℬ < k \mathcal{B}_{<k} 来缓解这一问题，该缓冲区存储了早期任务中的一部分演示，并在阶段 k k 时基于 𝒟 k ∪ ℬ < k \mathcal{D}_{k}\cup\mathcal{B}_{<k} 优化策略。 相比之下，我们研究的是无数据场景，即不保留任何先前任务的数据。 在适应某个任务后，只有该任务的指令和更新后的模型参数会延续到后续阶段，而该任务的演示和环境将不再可用。

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Sec. 3.2 , we generate rollouts with a fixed horizon T T for each task. Since the WAM is unable to recognize task completion, it keeps generating after the task is done, producing purposeless post-completion motion such as re-grasping the placed object or wandering around. Such motion enters training as if it were part of the task, which corrupts the learned behavior of the task. To remove it, we use a VLM as an agentic evaluator to identify the completion point of each of the M M candidate rollouts generated for a task. Rather than feeding the whole video, we subsample candidate frames from the later part of the rollout and annotate each frame with its step index, gripper command, and end-effector speed from the generated actions, so that the evaluator can localize the completion precisely. We further provide one in-context example from the same task, a generated rollout whose truncation range is annotated by a human (one per task), to calibrate its judgment. Given the task instruction and these inputs, the evaluator determines whether the task goal has been achieved and returns the end step t ^ end \hat{t}_{\mathrm{end}} , defined as the point where the completing motion has fully finished, e.g., the object has been released and the gripper has retreated. For tasks with multiple sub-goals, the end step corresponds to the completion of the final sub-goal. We then truncate the rollout at the chunk boundary following t ^ end \hat{t}_{\mathrm{end}} , so that the completed interaction is retained while the motion after it is excluded. Rollouts judged as not accomplishing the task are discarded. The evaluator prompt and a truncation example are given in Fig. A.5 and Fig. 9 in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 3.2 节所述，我们为每个任务生成具有固定时间步数 T 的 rollout。由于 WAM 无法识别任务是否完成，因此在任务结束后它仍会继续生成动作，产生无意义的后完成阶段运动，例如重新抓取已放置的物体或四处游荡。这类运动会像任务的一部分一样被纳入训练，从而破坏所学到的任务行为。为消除这一问题，我们使用一个 VLM 作为智能体评估器，以识别每个任务所生成的 M 个候选 rollout 中的完成点。为避免输入整个视频，我们从 rollout 的后半部分中抽取候选帧，并为每帧标注其步数索引、夹爪指令以及来自生成动作的末端执行器速度，以便评估器能够精确定位任务完成时刻。此外，我们还提供一个来自同一任务的上下文示例——一个由人类标注了截断范围的生成式 rollout（每个任务一个），以校准其判断能力。在给定任务说明和这些输入后，评估器会判断任务目标是否达成，并返回结束步数 t ^ end \hat{t}_{\mathrm{end}}，该步数定义为完成动作完全结束的时刻，例如物体已被释放且夹爪已收回。对于包含多个子目标的任务，结束步数对应于最后一个子目标的完成时刻。随后，我们会在 t ^ end \hat{t}_{\mathrm{end}} 之后的 chunk 边界处截断 rollout，从而保留已完成的部分交互，同时排除其后的运动。被判断为未完成任务的 rollout 将被丢弃。评估器提示词和一个截断示例分别列于附录中的图 A.5 和图 9。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate continual learning in simulation on LIBERO and in the real world on five sequentially learned manipulation tasks. For simulation , we use LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , a benchmark designed for continual learning in robotic manipulation. Its four suites, LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-10, each define a sequence of 10 tasks with 50 demonstrations per task. The four suites differ in what changes across tasks: the spatial layout, the manipulated object, the task goal, and long-horizon compositions of the three. For the real world , we design a sequence of five sandwich-making tasks on a robot with a 7-DoF arm and a 20-DoF dexterous hand, which observes the scene through a head camera and a wrist camera mounted on the hand (Fig. 3 ). Each task is instructed as “make a sandwich with ⟨ \langle ingredient ⟩ \rangle ”, with the ingredient being steak, luncheon meat, cheese, a fried egg, or a meat slice in learning order, and requires the robot to grasp the ingredient, place it on the bread, grasp the top bread, and cover the sandwich (Fig. 8 ). We collect 50 teleoperated demonstrations per task; hardware and protocol details are given in Appendix A.1 .

paragraphs.en: SR is the average performance over all tasks evaluated with the final checkpoint, i.e., after learning the last task; NBT (negative backward transfer) ( Liu et al., 2023 ) measures forgetting as the average drop of each task from the checkpoint that has just learned it to all later checkpoints; Plasticity is the average performance of each task at the checkpoint that has just learned it. Higher SR and Plasticity and lower NBT are better.
paragraphs.zh: SR 是在所有任务上使用最终检查点评估的平均性能，即在学习最后一个任务之后的性能；NBT（负向迁移）（Liu 等，2023）将遗忘衡量为每个任务从刚学习该任务的检查点到所有后续检查点的平均性能下降；可塑性则是每个任务在刚学习该任务的检查点上的平均性能。 SR 和可塑性越高、NBT 越低越好。

paragraphs.en: All methods share the same LingBot-VA backbone ( Li et al., 2026 ) , training schedule, and evaluation protocol. We consider two groups of baselines. The first group does not replay: sequential fine-tuning (Seq-FT), sequential fine-tuning of LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) (Seq-LoRA), EWC ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) , and LwF ( Li & Hoiem, 2018 ) . EWC constrains parameter updates with a quadratic penalty weighted by the Fisher importance of each parameter to previous tasks, and LwF regularizes the model by matching its predictions on new-task inputs to those of the previous model. The second group replays 20 episodes per previous task: experience replay (ER) ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ) replays real demonstrations and serves as an upper bound, while R-WAM replays the generated rollouts without rectification. R-WAM keeps all N = 20 N=20 rollouts it generates, whereas R 2 -WAM selects the same number from M = 40 M=40 candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法都共享相同的 LingBot-VA 主干网络（Li et al., 2026）、训练计划和评估协议。 我们考虑了两组基线模型。 第一组不重复播放：顺序微调（Seq-FT）、LoRA 适配器的顺序微调（Hu et al., 2022）（Seq-LoRA）、EWC（Kirkpatrick et al., 2017）和 LwF（Li & Hoiem, 2018）。 EWC 通过一个二次惩罚项来约束参数更新，该惩罚项的权重由每个参数对先前任务的重要性（根据 Fisher 信息量衡量）决定；而 LwF 则通过将模型在新任务输入上的预测结果与先前模型的预测结果进行匹配来实现正则化。 第二组对每个先前任务重复播放 20 个片段：经验重播（ER）（Rolnick et al., 2019）会重播真实的演示，并作为性能上限；而 R-WAM 则重播未经修正的生成轨迹。 R-WAM 保留其生成的全部 N = 20 个轨迹，而 R²-WAM 则从 M = 40 个候选轨迹中选出相同数量的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares R 2 -WAM with the no-replay and replay baselines on the four LIBERO suites; all replay methods use the same buffer size of 20 episodes per previous task. We draw three observations. First , without replay, the WAM forgets almost everything it has learned: Seq-FT, Seq-LoRA, EWC, and LwF reach an average SR of only 11–15% with an NBT of 67–80, although their Plasticity stays above 84%. Second , without any real data from previous tasks, R 2 -WAM reaches an average SR of 92.7% and an NBT of 2.33, only 1.9 pp below ER on average, which serves as an upper bound since it replays real demonstrations of previous tasks. The gap is largest on LIBERO-10 ( 5.2 pp), consistent with its long-horizon tasks, where observation–action drift may accumulate over longer rollouts. Finally , replaying raw rollouts substantially reduces forgetting relative to Seq-FT, raising the average SR from 12.5% to 70.4%, but still lags ER by a wide margin, which shows the necessity of rectification.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了 R 2 -WAM 与无重播和重播基线方法在四个 LIBERO 套件上的表现；所有重播方法均使用相同的缓冲区大小，即每个先前任务 20 个episode。 我们得出三个观察结果。 首先，在没有重播的情况下，WAM 几乎会忘记它所学到的一切：Seq-FT、Seq-LoRA、EWC 和 LwF 的平均 SR 仅为 11–15%，NBT 为 67–80，尽管它们的可塑性仍保持在 84% 以上。 其次，在没有来自先前任务的任何真实数据的情况下，R 2 -WAM 的平均 SR 达到 92.7%，NBT 为 2.33，仅比 ER 平均低 1.9 pp；而 ER 由于重播了先前任务的真实演示，因此构成了一个上限。 这种差距在 LIBERO-10 上最大（5.2 pp），这与该套件的长时域任务一致，在这些任务中，观察值与动作之间的漂移可能会在更长的执行过程中累积。 最后，重播原始执行记录与 Seq-FT 相比显著减少了遗忘现象，将平均 SR 从 12.5% 提高到 70.4%，但仍远低于 ER，这表明进行修正的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares R 2 -WAM with Seq-FT and ER on the five real-world tasks, where the trend matches simulation: Seq-FT suffers catastrophic forgetting (28.5% SR, 65.62 NBT), whereas R 2 -WAM retains previous tasks nearly as well as ER (89.5% versus 91.8% SR, 3.45 versus 2.27 NBT) without any real data from previous tasks. Both replay methods also give up 4–5 pp of Plasticity relative to Seq-FT, which we attribute to interference among co-trained tasks ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , here between tasks that differ only in a visually similar target. First , removing either component degrades performance, from 94.0% SR to 80.8% without filtering and to 70.8% without truncation, so both are necessary. paragraphs.en: To examine adaptive truncation itself, we sample five generated rollouts from each of the 40 LIBERO tasks, annotate an acceptable range of truncation steps for each of the 200 samples, and count a predicted truncation as correct if it falls inside the range. Table 4 ablates the VLM evaluator and its prompt on this set. First , stronger VLMs truncate more accurately, from 73.5% for Qwen3-VL to 93.5% for GPT-5.6 Sol; we use Terra (91.0%) in all other experiments to balance accuracy against cost. Second , removing the in-context example lowers accuracy to 78.0%, likely because where a task ends is inherently ambiguous and the example anchors the VLM’s notion of completion. Finally , removing the action annotations lowers accuracy to 76.0%, suggesting that the moment of completion is often hard to tell from observations alone and the motion cues of the actions help.

paragraphs.en: To compare the replay data of ER and R 2 -WAM more directly, we visualize the trajectories of the real demonstrations and the generated rollouts of a LIBERO-Spatial task in Fig. 6 , where the 40 generated rollouts are all adaptively truncated and then split by the physical-consistency filtering into 20 selected and 20 filtered out. We draw three observations from the comparison. First , the generated trajectories follow the same pattern as the real ones in Fig. 6 (a), but they gradually deviate from the real ones as the rollout proceeds, which is evident in Fig. 6 (b), where the release positions deviate much more than the grasp positions. paragraphs.en: To examine the effect of the replay buffer size, we scale it from 1 to 50 episodes per task on LIBERO-Spatial and compare R 2 -WAM with ER at every size, as shown in Fig. 6 . paragraphs.en: We presented R 2 -WAM, a data-free approach to continual learning for world action models. A WAM can regenerate rollouts of previously learned tasks from their instructions alone, but such rollouts cannot be replayed directly for two reasons: the WAM does not stop generating at task completion, and its generated observations gradually drift from the generated actions. R 2 -WAM addresses both issues with rectified generative replay, which truncates each rollout at task completion and filters out physically inconsistent ones before replay. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R 2 -WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly reaches experience replay without retaining any data from previous tasks. Ablations confirm that both truncation and filtering are necessary, and our analysis shows that forgetting in a WAM concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling while video prediction is largely preserved. This explains why a WAM can regenerate its past for replay and points to the action side as the part to verify.

paragraphs.en: ① Platform and data. As shown in Fig. 3 , the robot is a 7-DoF arm with a 20-DoF dexterous hand, observed by a head camera and a wrist camera. Observations are recorded at 30 Hz and resized to 256 × 320 256\times 320 , and the action is the 27-dimensional joint command. We fine-tune the WAM on the 50 demonstrations of each task with the same schedule as in LIBERO. ② Tasks. The five tasks share a tabletop with a plate holding a slice of bread, a rack of five ingredients, and a stack of bread, as illustrated in Fig. 8 . They differ only in the instructed ingredient and the grasp it demands, so forgetting manifests as picking the wrong ingredient or failing the grasp. ③ Scoring. Each trial is scored on four steps independently, one point each: the instructed ingredient is lifted off the rack, it rests on the bread, the top bread is lifted, and the sandwich is covered. The first two steps earn no point if a wrong ingredient is used, whereas the last two are identical across tasks, so a policy that has forgotten the ingredient can still earn up to half the points. The progress rate is the score divided by four, averaged over 20 trials per task, and SR, NBT, and Plasticity are all computed on it in place of the binary success.

paragraphs.en: For each learned task, R 2 -WAM samples 40 candidate rollouts from the instruction alone. The generation horizon of a task is set to ⌊ L ¯ / 16 ⌋ + 2 \lfloor\bar{L}/16\rfloor+2 action chunks of 16 steps, where L ¯ \bar{L} is the mean length of its demonstrations, i.e., about two chunks longer than a typical demonstration; the resulting ranges for the four suites are given in Table 5 . We use the demonstration length only as a convenient way to set this horizon, and it carries no information about the task beyond a rough duration: in practice the horizon can equally be set from a human estimate of how long the task takes, or by probing the model with a few generated rollouts of the task before replay. Moreover, because completion-aware truncation cuts every rollout at task completion, the horizon only needs to be long enough, and its exact value has little effect on the replay data.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个已学习的任务，R²-WAM 仅根据指令采样出 40 个候选执行序列。 一个任务的生成时域设为 ⌊L¯/16⌋+2 个各含 16 步的动作片段，其中 L¯ 是其演示的平均长度，即比典型演示长约两个片段；四个套件对应的具体范围见表 5。 我们仅将演示长度作为设定该时域的便捷方式，它本身并不包含除大致持续时间之外的任务信息：实际上，该时域同样可以通过对人类对任务所需时间的估计来设定，或在重播前通过生成几个任务的执行序列来探测模型以确定。 此外，由于完成感知截断会在任务完成时切断每个执行序列，因此时域只需足够长即可，其具体数值对重播数据的影响极小。

sents.en: The generation horizon of a task is set to ⌊ L ¯ / 16 ⌋ + 2 \lfloor\bar{L}/16\rfloor+2 action chunks of 16 steps, where L ¯ \bar{L} is the mean length of its demonstrations, i.e., about two chunks longer than a typical demonstration; the resulting ranges for the four suites are given in Table 5 .

sents.en: We use the demonstration length only as a convenient way to set this horizon, and it carries no information about the task beyond a rough duration: in practice the horizon can equally be set from a human estimate of how long the task takes, or by probing the model with a few generated rollouts of the task before replay.

sents.en: Moreover, because completion-aware truncation cuts every rollout at task completion, the horizon only needs to be long enough, and its exact value has little effect on the replay data.

paragraphs.en: The evaluator is a VLM queried with the task instruction and two parts of visual evidence, with the full prompt given in Fig. A.5 of Appendix A.5 . Part 1 is an in-context example: a generated rollout of the same task in which a human has marked the range of acceptable truncation steps, so that the VLM learns what completion looks like for this task. Part 2 is the candidate rollout to be judged. Instead of the whole video, we uniformly sample frames from the last part of the rollout, every 2 steps over the final 20% or at least 40 steps. Frames at which a motion ends or the gripper releases, as detected from the generated actions, are tagged [BOUNDARY] and the others [SAMPLE] , since the correct truncation usually falls at a boundary. Every frame pairs the external and the wrist view of one step, and we additionally attach its step index, gripper command, and end-effector velocity, along with a summary of the motion segments detected from the generated actions. Fig. 9 shows an example, where the placement, the release, and the upward retreat are retained while the subsequent re-grasping loop is removed.

paragraphs.en: REGEN ( Govind et al., 2026 ) also replays generated rollouts, but initializes each rollout from a real observation of the previous task, which requires retaining those observations. To quantify what this buys, we build a ReGen-style variant of our own pipeline: each rollout is initialized from a real initial observation of the task instead of one generated from the instruction, and no consistency filtering is applied, since REGEN has no counterpart to it. REGEN ends a rollout with the value head of its Cosmos Policy backbone ( Kim et al., 2026a ) , which LingBot-VA does not have; we therefore truncate its rollouts with the same VLM evaluator as R 2 -WAM, so that both variants stop at task completion. As shown in Table 7 , the ReGen-style variant reaches 68.0% SR on LIBERO-Spatial, far below the 94.0% of R 2 -WAM, indicating that retaining real observations to start from does not substitute for regenerating and rectifying rollouts from the instruction alone.
paragraphs.zh: REGEN（Govind 等，2026）也会重播生成的展开序列，但每次展开序列都从上一任务的真实观测开始初始化，这要求保留这些观测数据。 为了量化这种做法带来的提升，我们构建了一个基于 ReGen 风格的自身流程变体：每个展开序列都从任务的真实初始观测开始初始化，而不是从指令生成的初始观测开始，并且不应用一致性过滤，因为 REGEN 没有对应的机制。 REGEN 使用其 Cosmos Policy 主干模型（Kim 等，2026a）的值头来结束展开序列，而 LingBot-VA 没有这一部分；因此，我们用与 R 2 -WAM 相同的 VLM 评估器截断其展开序列，以确保两种变体都在任务完成时停止。 如表 7 所示，ReGen 风格的变体在 LIBERO-Spatial 上的 SR 仅为 68.0%，远低于 R 2 -WAM 的 94.0%，这表明保留真实观测作为起点并不能替代仅从指令出发重新生成和修正展开序列的做法。

At a buffer size of 1, the deficit of ER comes from a few tasks (T2, T4, and T7) that collapse to 22–42% once later tasks are learned, whereas R 2 -WAM degrades mildly on several tasks but never falls below 50% on any of them, which supports the conjecture that a generated rollout is a more stable anchor than a single real demonstration. paragraphs.en: Fig. 11 shows representative trials behind Table 3 , from which we draw three observations. First , Seq-FT is highly plastic but forgets, and the forgetting worsens as more tasks are learned, as shown from top to bottom in Fig. 11 (a). Right after learning a task, the robot completes all four steps. After one more task is learned, it already skips the steak and completes only the two bread steps. As training continues, the bread steps degrade as well: three tasks later the robot still grasps the bread but releases it off the plate, and four tasks later it completes no step at all. Second , ER and R 2 -WAM both retain previous tasks, and four tasks later both still complete the first task with the same motion, as shown in Fig. 11 (b). Finally , both replay methods still lose some precision on previous tasks, and their failures are alike. In all three trials of Fig. 11 (c), the robot grasps the instructed ingredient and completes both bread steps, and fails only at placing: the fried egg slips from the hand in transit, for ER and R 2 -WAM alike, or the cheese is released at the edge of the bread and slides off. This loss of placement precision is consistent with the task interference discussed in Section 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 11 展示了表 3 背后的代表性试验，从中我们得出三个观察结果。 首先，Seq-FT 具有高度可塑性但会遗忘，并且随着学习更多任务，遗忘现象会加剧，如图 11 (a) 从上到下所示。 在学习一个任务后，机器人能完成全部四个步骤。 再学习一个任务后，它就已经跳过牛排，只完成面包的两个步骤。 随着训练继续，面包步骤也会退化：三个任务之后，机器人虽然仍能抓起面包，但会将其从盘子上放下；四个任务之后，它则完全无法完成任何步骤。 其次，ER 和 R2-WAM 都能保留之前的任务，四个任务之后两者仍然以相同的动作完成第一个任务，如图 11 (b) 所示。 最后，两种重播方法在先前任务上的精度仍有所损失，且它们的失败表现相似。 在图 11 (c) 的全部三次试验中，机器人都能抓起指定的食材并完成面包的两个步骤，但仅在放置环节失败：对于 ER 和 R2-WAM 而言，煎蛋都会在传送过程中从手中滑落，或者奶酪会在面包边缘被放下并滑落。 这种放置精度的损失与第 4.2 节中讨论的任务干扰一致。
